experiment: Splay GC pacing cost diagnostic on Apple M4
decision: do not tighten the large-heap allocation headroom yet; measured mark+sweep share is 12.94%, and the prior Linux live/2 trial reduced Score 16.94%

measurement.score_note: Profile build score is diagnostic only and excluded from performance comparisons.

pacing_model.current_large_heap_headroom: one live-cell count of allocations after collection

if_headroom_halved.interpretation: rough score loss estimate assuming collection count doubles and per-collection work is unchanged

measurement.decision_basis: Measured 12.94% is above the suggested 10% cutoff; the simple model predicts about 11.46% score loss for half headroom. Prior Linux results likewise do not justify this policy change before collections are cheaper.

profile_integrity.note: GC counters were emitted before the existing post-run dispatch accounting assertion. Diagnostic estimate only, not qualification.
